content.title: What Is ‘Barakah Pass’, Who Is It For, and How to Activate It?
content.subtitle: Our humble endeavor to keep the journey toward our Lord accessible to all
content.body:
For nearly 12 years, Muslims Day has been working with a single goal: to help a believer make today better in good deeds than yesterday.

Almost all the essential daily deeds required in a Muslim’s 24-hour routine have been brought together on this single platform: accurate prayer times, Quran recitation, Tafsir, and audio listening, morning and evening Masnoon Adhkar, a digital Tasbih, authentic Zakat calculation, and Ruqyah audio. Alongside these are gentle reminders appearing on the screen amidst the busyness of daily work—reminding you to send blessings upon the Prophet ﷺ during a quick pause, or prompting you to seek forgiveness (Istighfar) from your Lord in remorse for shortcomings.

What is ‘Barakah Pass’ and Who Is It For?

Yet, our core aspiration is not to remain limited only to those who can afford it; rather, it is to see the spiritual life of every individual flourish.

We deeply realize that there are many of our brothers and sisters in faith who, at this moment, cannot afford a monthly subscription of even 100 BDT. But the thought that a believer would be deprived of these special reminders and opportunities to refine their daily deeds simply due to a lack of money does not sit right with our religious conscience.

That is why we introduced ‘Barakah Pass’—a special initiative offering complete, free access to all premium features for those in financial difficulty. This is neither charity nor favor, but a gift of sincere love to you as our brothers and sisters in faith; in return, we ask for nothing except your heartfelt prayers (Dua) before our Lord.

How to Activate the Barakah Pass?

Without any hassle, you can activate the Barakah Pass directly from the app in just a few clicks:

  • Go to the ‘Subscribe’ button from the app menu.

  • Scroll down on the subscription page and tap the ‘Get Barakah Pass’ option.

  • On the next page, check the terms/pledge box and tap the ‘Activate Barakah Pass’ button below.

  • Then tap ‘Return to App’, and the premium (Silver Member) benefits will be instantly activated on your profile for 30 days.

To clearly understand how to easily activate the Barakah Pass step-by-step, a short video guide is provided below:

Video Tutorial: https://mahfil.net/clips/2VGyyBi0bFz

Your Feedback is Our Inspiration

Do you believe that a family of 10 million can come together to help 1 million people become better Muslims today than they were yesterday?

We, the Muslims Day team, aim to provide 1 million people with the 'Barakah Pass' by 2027 to make their life of worship more beautiful and blessed. You can share your valuable thoughts with us by filling out the form below. Any feedback and suggestions you have will help make our journey ahead smoother, In sha Allah.
